ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across approximately 95% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels restricted to localized scars and peripheral edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (dark grey/black) field across the macro-surface; high-contrast focal spots (white/light grey) localized at the distal tips and in clustered circular configurations on the left lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped depression dividing the lobes with a sharp vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys across the entire trailing edge boundary; notable deep indentations present on the inner margin of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve sweeping upward toward sharp, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of approximately four circular ring-shaped high-contrast pixel configurations located in the mid-to-outer region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, diagonal, parallel light-colored linear streaks (rake marks) detected on the upper-central region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Rough, high-intensity calcified clusters consistent with barnacle colonization present at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; visible jagged trauma or deep notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the central division.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'O-ring' shaped scarring pattern on the left lobe.
